findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#w0" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Rotating element's bounding-box center drifts 2047px across rotation — it is not spinning about its own center (check transformOrigin/svgOrigin).
findings.fixHint: The bounding-box center should stay fixed while the element spins; check its transformOrigin/svgOrigin so rotation pivots about the element's own center rather than a point in a coordinate space it was resized out of.
